name: sls-ninja
description: Work your sls.ninja sales pipeline from ChatGPT: leads, clients, deals, to-dos, calendar and email drafts.

interface.longDescription: Connect your sls.ninja account and ChatGPT can work in your sales workspace: search your leads, clients, companies and prospects, read a person's timeline, see the deal pipeline, your to-dos, calendar and recent email, open an email conversation in full, and the replies Ninja, the sls.ninja assistant, has drafted. With your permission it can add and tick off to-dos, log calls, meetings and notes, move deals between stages, and save, change and delete email drafts in your own mailbox for you to check, including replies that stay in the same conversation. It can never send email. You choose what it may do when you connect, and can disconnect it any time from your Account page.
defaultPrompt: What needs my attention in sls.ninja today?
Show me my open deals and what stage each is in.
Log a call with a lead and add a follow-up to-do.

positive.prompt: What needs my attention in sls.ninja today?
positive.expected_behavior: A short list ordered by urgency: overdue to-dos, today's meetings, drafted replies, deals past their close date, with two or three next steps.

positive.description: Look up a person and their history.
positive.prompt: Who is Maya Castellano and what's happened with her lately?
positive.expected_behavior: Maya Castellano's title, company and stage, her recent timeline entries, open to-dos and deals.

positive.prompt: Show me my open deals and what stage each is in.
positive.expected_behavior: Each open deal with its value, stage, company and expected close date.

positive.description: Add a to-do in a brand.
positive.prompt: Add a to-do in Demo Company to call Harbor Light Realty next Monday.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the to-do was added with its title and due date in the Demo Company brand.

positive.description: Log a call on a contact's timeline.
positive.prompt: Log a call with Maya Castellano: she wants a proposal by Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms a call was logged on Maya Castellano's timeline with that note.

negative.description: Do not trigger for general sales advice.
negative.prompt: Give me five tips for a better cold call opener.
Send Maya Castellano an email saying the proposal is attached.
Delete every lead in sls.ninja that hasn't replied in a month.

review.commerce_description: sls.ninja does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.1: open an email conversation in full; find sent email by who it went to; save a reply as a draft in the same conversation, which makes nothing when they have already answered (automatic replies don't count), the email bounced, or a draft is already waiting; list, change and delete unsent drafts in your own mailboxes. Nothing can send email.
